Vanessa — thanks for the ping. Initial read below (top risks first). I'm attaching a short spreadsheet with line references.

1) Indemnity / limitation carveouts (High risk)
- Nimbus added a carveout for regulatory fines and broadly worded third-party claims. We should push back: carveouts should be narrowly tailored to data breaches attributable to Redwood negligence. Accepting a broad carveout materially increases our liability. Proposed counter: limit carveout to direct regulatory fines arising from unauthorized data access attributable to Redwood's breach, subject to our indemnity cap.

2) Audit rights / data residency (Medium-High)
- They request on-site audit rights and persistent access to logs. We can offer SOC2 report and a quarterly compliance summary; on-site audits need to be scoped and reimbursed. For data residency we can confirm region-specific hosting (US-east) but cannot guarantee physical segregation beyond our VPC tenancy unless they purchase a private deployment.

3) SLA & acceptance window (Medium)
- They shortened the acceptance period to 3 business days. Recommend keeping 10 business days; propose 7 as compromise for pilot.

Attached: Redline_Summary.xlsx with suggested edits and justification notes. If legal wants to do tracked changes directly in their doc I can produce a tracked MSA counter.

If this is time-sensitive and they pushed for week of Sep 6, I can prioritize a tracked counter this afternoon if you want to escalate.
